name: Spring Step
text: Move forward 3. Stop before the throne; your new section does not activate.
flavor: A little spring in your very small step.

name: Paper Glider
text: If your normal die showed 1 or 2, move forward 5. Stop before the throne; no new landing effect.

name: Pocket Compass
text: Move back 1 or 2. Choose your distance; the new section does not activate.
flavor: The scenic route is occasionally the clever one.

name: Second Bounce
text: Roll one bonus die and move forward its value. Stop before the throne. This bonus move cannot trigger a section or win.
flavor: The trampoline has one more opinion.

name: Catch-up Kite
text: If you are uniquely last and at least 10 sections behind the front position, move forward 4. Stop before the throne; no landing effect.
flavor: A friendly gust for the long way home.

name: Bridge Pass
text: Move to the next portal if it is within 6 sections ahead. Do not activate it. This move cannot reach the throne.
flavor: The bridge keeper likes your little hat.

name: Bubble Coat
text: Arm one shield. It automatically blocks the next harmful board event or rival card, then pops. Shields do not stack.

name: Leaf Umbrella
text: Cancel one harmful board effect: a trap, setback or bad-chest card. Stay on the source section and keep any threatened Sparks or cards.

name: Nope Stamp
text: Cancel one rival card targeting you. Their card and Sparks are still spent.

name: Soft Landing
text: Reduce one harmful backward move by 3, to a minimum of 0. Your final section does not activate.
flavor: Moss has been preparing for this moment.

name: Rug Tug
text: Choose a rival 1–6 sections ahead. Move them back 3. Their landing does not activate; defense may block this.
flavor: It was a very small rug.

name: Sticky Shoes
text: Choose a rival within 8 sections. They slip back 2 now. Their landing does not activate; defense may block this.
flavor: Someone stepped in the group chat.

name: Pocket Audit
text: Choose a rival within 4 sections who has Sparks. Transfer up to 2 Sparks to you, within your cap. Defense may block this.

name: Windy Pockets
text: Choose a rival within 6 sections who has a card. They discard one random hand card. Resolve defense before revealing that card.

name: Pocket Picnic
text: Gain 3 Sparks, up to the limit of 15.

name: Curiosity Bag
text: Draw 2 item cards. Keep 1 and discard the other. If your hand exceeds 3, choose a card to discard.
flavor: There is always one more pocket.

name: Spare Parts
text: Discard one other hand card. Gain 4 Sparks, up to the limit of 15.

name: Swap Meet
text: Set aside 1 or 2 other hand cards. Draw that many replacements, then discard the set-aside cards.
